brief:
Women filmmakers in Gaza have established a new film academy to document stories of survival and resilience during the ongoing conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. The initiative emerged from a Gaza film festival that showcased works addressing themes of war, loss, and perseverance by female directors and producers in the territory.

The academy represents an effort by Palestinian women to transform personal trauma into cinema while maintaining creative practice under conditions of displacement and conflict. Filmmakers have used the platform to record narratives that might otherwise go undocumented as the humanitarian situation in Gaza continues to deteriorate.
dek: Gaza film festival highlights women's resilience through stories of war, loss and survival.
title: Gaza women filmmakers launch academy amid war
